questions.question: In his suffering, Job asked a question about people and God. What was Job asking?

answers.text: How a person can be righteous before God
How a person can win back all he has lost
How a person can win the respect of his friends

questions.question: Job spoke of God moving mountains, shaking the earth and sealing off the stars. What was Job showing about God?

answers.text: How gently He tends the earth
How He rests after His work

questions.question: In his suffering, Job begged God not to condemn him. What did Job ask God to let him know?

answers.text: How long he had left to live

questions.question: When Job pleaded with God not to destroy him, what did Job say God had molded him like?
